title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. My friends went by bus for umrah last week from Riyadh via Medina when they reached near to Mecca. The check post authorities(police) stopped them and other pilgrims and ans ordered to go back to medina. Therefore they returned to medina and and took off ahraam and returned back to Riyadh after Juma prayer in Medina. So is there any penalty for not doing umrah due the said reason, please advise. 2997 views Q. Kissing the forehead of sister after returning from Umrah 2740 views Q. missing tawaf round? 3153 views Q. abandoned Tawaf after giving it a start 4864 views Q. During the month of Ramzan there is lot of crowd in the Haram so much so after we perform Nafl Tawafs during the Last 10 days of Ramzan especially in the late nights we are prevented by the authorities to say our Nafl Namaz of the Tawaf immediately anywhere in the Mataf area or anywhere in the Haram because the whole of Haram is packed with people saying there Shabina Namaz. During these circustances can we continue to perform 2 or more Nafl Tawafs at a stretch and later say our Nafl Namaz of Tawaf in 2 rakaats each for the number of Tawafs we had performed ? 2] Because of the vast crowd it becomes inevitable that we sometimes are forced to cross in front of people who are saying their namaz in the Haram. Is is Ok if this happens due to the situation prevelant in the Haram? 2521 views Q. Applying oil or cream to the face while in the status of ihram 19714 views Q. Offering two rakaat after tawaf 13198 views Q. Listening of Hajj Khutba is necessary? 4995 views Q. Performing Umrah after returning from Tai’f 6812 views Q. Asak ! I am student of Jawaharl lal Nehru University in New Delhi and doing research in the Centre for Study of Law and Governance. I want to ask that : Is subsidy for Haj provided by the Government of India valid or in accordance with the islamic principles or requirements? 1936 views Q. After hajj, we went to masjid ayesha for jiyaarah only and did not intended to perform Umra. We performed Two rakat namaj and came back . Is there any problem being coming out of Haram(masjid-e-ayesha )before performing Tawaful Wida? After one week we performed Tawaful Wida just before leaving Makka Mukarma. 3315 views Q. My age is 44 yesrs & I have not done my Haj so far but,intended to do in the near future with wife.I want to do Haj-e-badal for my late grand father who died without doing his own Haj. I have been under debt,the loan has been taken from Individuals as well as Bank to fulfill various needs including house constuction.My wife is pregnent & she can't go for Haj this year.Two daughters are very small-6 & 3 yrs old respectively. The expense of late grand father's Haj-e-badal has to be born by my parents,who are also going for their Haj this year. Now my question is :- Taking into above facts & circumstances,Can I do the Haj-e-badal for my late grand father without doing my own Haj? 1823 views Q. equilibrium in nafl expenditures between wife and parents 1718 views Q. Assalam-o-Alikum, Mufti sahib I want to know that is it compulsory to take permission of the parents to go for umrah and haj? And also explain that I am doing job in Dubai and I want to go for umrah from here so parent's permission is must or not? jazakALLAH 3829 views Q. What should I do if I crossed the miqat multiple times during Umrah while in hayd without observing the rules of Ihram? Do I need to give damm? 3275 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 39838 Country: Pakistan Title: I performed Umrah and forget o shave head/cut hair and removed Ihram Question: I performed Umrah and forget o shave head/cut hair and removed Ihram, and later when I went to sleep, then I remembered that I did not cut hair and removed Ihram. I want to ask what Kaffarah is for that. And how many types of Kaffarah if someone cannot do like dam (sacrifice animal)? Please answer in details. Answer ID: 39838 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 997/630/H=1433) It is wajib to shave and cut the hair if they are equal to one finger tip. You will not turn halal if you do not do the same. In order to know the ruling of dam (slaughtering of animal) write us the details of jinayat (fault) you committed before shaving or cutting the hair. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
